repos.description: mall项目是一套电商系统，包括前台商城系统及后台管理系统，基于Spring Boot+MyBatis实现，采用Docker容器化部署。 前台商城系统包含首页门户、商品推荐、商品搜索、商品展示、购物车、订单流程、会员中心、客户服务、帮助中心等模块。 后台管理系统包含商品管理、订单管理、会员管理、促销管理、运营管理、内容管理、统计报表、财务管理、权限管理、设置等模块。
repos.summary_zh: mall 是一个完整的电商系统，包含基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis 的前台商城和后台管理系统，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前台涵盖商品展示、搜索、购物车、订单流程等核心电商功能；后台提供商品、订单、会员、促销等全链路管理。集成 Elasticsearch、Redis、RabbitMQ 等主流中间件，适合企业级电商项目开发与学习。
repos.summary_en: Mall is a full-featured e-commerce system with front-end portal and back-end management, built on Spring Boot + MyBatis and deployed via Docker. It includes product display, search, cart, checkout, and user management on the frontend, and supports comprehensive backend operations like inventory, orders, promotions, and analytics. Integrated with Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, and other modern technologies, it serves as a robust platform for enterprise-level e-commerce development and learning.

repos.description: weixin pay python 微信支付功能集，前期开发借鉴zwczou https://github.com/zwczou/weixin-python ，后期补充及完善微信支付新功能，处理因微信支付调用规则修改而无法使用的旧代码，升级到最新微信支付接口配套代码
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个已停止维护的微信支付 Python SDK，提供完整的微信支付功能封装，包括 JSAPI 支付下单、订单查询、退款、红包发放、企业付款及刷卡支付等接口。基于 zwczou/weixin-python 开发，后期适配微信支付接口规则变更，支持证书认证和回调通知，适用于需要集成微信支付功能的 Python 后端服务。
repos.summary_en: This is a discontinued Python SDK for WeChat Pay, offering comprehensive API support including JSAPI payments, order queries, refunds, red packet distribution, enterprise transfers, and swipe-card payments. Built upon zwczou/weixin-python with updates to comply with WeChat Pay's evolving API standards, it supports certificate authentication and webhook notifications for secure payment processing in Python backends.

repos.summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
repos.summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.
